rules_evaluated.rule_lead: One exercise = one bounded activity.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency — adults decide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forced-pacing language ('sit N min', 'don't scan'). The one move with no attached prompt (spot-check, lines 42-43) is phrased as an offer ('You can spot-check it'), not a compulsion, and creates no dead end for later steps.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Delegation — student brings, Claude screens.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: One skill (context-window awareness via read+introspect+verify) and one artifact (the context map named in 'What you build:', line 15); no natural pause requiring an artifact hand-off mid-file. Maintainer meta confirms atomic shape (line 72).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-realism check.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique — default.

The one no-prompt beat (spot-check, lines 42-43) is light homework/conversational-fold register under Boundary 2, not load-bearing machinery a later step consumes.
